title: A Vibe anchored on a film they only liked, and a Vibe whose sentence names what only its core has
construction_note: docs/work/vibe-refit. Before Sunrise and Only God Forgives are absent on purpose: the requests introduce them. Walk and Talk is anchored on Before Sunset, which they only liked, and its sentence is true of Before Sunrise as it stands — so a loved Before Sunrise is filed there with no new wording, and offered as its core in place of Before Sunset, which stays in it. Neon and Silence is anchored on Drive, which they loved, and its sentence names Los Angeles, which only Drive has: Only God Forgives is the same evening — a city after dark, a man who barely speaks, a synth score — in Bangkok, so it is filed there with the exact new wording that loosens or drops the city, and is never offered as the core (it is only liked, and Drive is loved).

genres.name: Talky
genres.instruction: Films I watch for how people talk to each other; the plot can wait.

genres.name: Romance
genres.instruction: I like watching two people slowly fall for each other.

genres.name: Neo-Noir
genres.instruction: I like lonely people in cities at night, and the line somebody crosses.

genres.name: Synth Score
genres.instruction: I like a soundtrack of synthesisers that sets the mood more than the dialogue does.

vibes.name: Walk and Talk
vibes.instruction: Two people, one long conversation as they walk, and nothing at stake but what they'll be to each other.

vibes.name: Neon and Silence
vibes.instruction: Los Angeles after dark, a man who barely speaks, and a synth score doing the talking.
